# Extras JavaScript and Sass reference index

Derived from the documentation catalogue's `exports` and `styles` ownership for `@expressivecss/extras`. Core exports and partials are indexed by the `expressivecss` skill.

Contents: [JavaScript exports](#javascript-exports), [Sass partials](#sass-partials).

## JavaScript exports

Import names from `@expressivecss/extras`, or read them from the `ExpressiveExtras` global of the IIFE bundle. Core `AutoInit` starts these components once extras is loaded. Per-element components inherit `init`, `getInstance` and `destroy`.
